notes.title: Update 1.1 is live now!
notes.content:
[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/Y7qyLqd/Render-616x353.png[/img][/url]
[h1]Update 1.1 is live now![/h1]

[h2]New perks and build system at each run[/h2]
Now you can select different upgrades to create your own and unique build to fight against your enemies.
[list]
[*]12 different upgrades with 5 levels of rarity
[*]Control multiples katanas at once
[*]Summon thunders from above to kill your enemies
[*]Be the master of explosions
[*]Throw an infinite number of Ranged Weapons
[/list]
[h2]New Meta Progression system[/h2]
Collect coins by killing enemies to improve yourself and proceed to the next levels

notes.title: Update 1.0.2 is live now!
notes.content:
[img]https://ibb.co/5jVM6qF[/img]
Update 1.0.2 is live now, and with this update we must show some more love to the Sparkling Katana!
[list]
[*]Sparkling Katana shots are now easier to land
[*]Sparkling Katana's max ammo are now 20 rounds
[*]The max number of enemies in a level is now 14 (the game has become more difficult!)
[/list]
